titulo: Fecho integrado v394 e core genuino de grafo da mesma Fock
resultado: The same Fock has Weyl/CCR, a standard wedge vacuum, closed pair Tomita, positive exponential lift and regular covariant core with faithful embedding and dual action. Independent recompilation confirms a genuine graph core in F x F, approximating input and image together. Local construction now proves Sexp is contained in S_pair. The reverse inclusion and polar/KMS identification remain open.
defeito: Identificacao polar, traco, rede global/materia conjuntos e novo main pendentes.
proximo_passo: Concluir igualdade Tomita e corrigir KH-N1 para o rito integral da candidata.
